helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: Benzodioxolefentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of fentanyl analogs are similar to those of fentanyl itself, which include itching, nausea and potentially serious respiratory depression, which can be life-threatening. Fentanyl analogs have killed hundreds of people throughout Europe and the former Soviet republics since the most recent resurgence in use began in Estonia in the early 2000s, and novel derivatives continue to appear.

pharmacology.en: Like fentanyl, it acts on the mu-opioid receptor. Activating that receptor dampens pain signals and also slows the brainstem centres that drive breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 和芬太尼一樣，它作用於 μ 鴉片受體。活化該受體會抑制疼痛訊號，同時也減緩驅動呼吸的腦幹中樞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和芬太尼一样，它作用于 μ 鸦片受体。活化该受体会抑制疼痛信号，同时也减缓驱动呼吸的脑干中枢。

fact.en: It carries the methylenedioxy ring found in MDMA and safrole in place of one of fentanyl's rings, an unusual crossing of two very different drug families.
fact.zh: 它以 MDMA 與黃樟素中的亞甲二氧基環取代芬太尼的其中一個環，是兩個截然不同藥物家族之間罕見的交叉。
fact.zhHans: 它以 MDMA 与黄樟素中的亚甲二氧基环取代芬太尼的其中一个环，是两个截然不同药物家族之间罕见的交叉。
